classification: Model configuration experiment through the real API; not a production model change

dataset.name: database-agent-model-eval

fixtures.ecommerce: Cedar Lane sample database (deploy/demo/ecommerce): 8 reference questions incl. one chart request, 1 unanswerable
fixtures.clinic: Riverbend Clinics (tests/evaluation/model_eval/fixtures/clinic): many-to-many clinician/location, shifts vs appointments grain, partial payments; 8 questions, 1 unanswerable

dataset.ground_truth: Python over generated rows, equal to reference SQL on the loaded database before grading

grading: LLM judge gpt-6.1-sol (reasoning medium, structured verdict) against ground truth; mechanical exact-table match kept as evidence; SQL re-executed as the read-only role; models used per node verified against the config (72/72 per run)

runs.actions_run: development repository CI run 40197885883 (private; link omitted)
runs.cost_note: Cost in this run is undercounted: table selection made an unrecorded model call (fixed in PR 109). Use run 2 for cost.

runs.actions_run: development repository CI run 40200542724 (private; link omitted)

where_the_cheaper_config_fails: clinic_utilization_march 0/4: joins shifts to appointments before aggregating (fan-out), every utilization wrong
clinic_multi_clinician_patients 1/4: counts no-show appointments as 'seen' (358 instead of 328)
where_the_baseline_fails: ecom_monthly_revenue 2/4: gpt-6.1-sol appended LIMIT 10 to a 12-month question (DA-LIMIT-001; 17/36 baseline queries ended in LIMIT 10, 0/36 for gpt-6-luna)
decision: No production model change from one experiment. Luna is ~6.7x cheaper per answer and ~1 s faster at p50, but loses multi-grain aggregation and definition inference on the structurally different schema. Candidate next experiment: Sol for sql_generation only, Luna for table selection/db routing/pandas (table selection is 35% of baseline cost).
limits: 18 questions, 2 synthetic schemas, 4 answers per case per config across two runs
Latency measured on GitHub-hosted runners against the public OpenAI API; absolute values vary run to run (p50 9.7 s vs 11.5 s for the same config)
Cost is a list-price estimate; embeddings and follow-up suggestions excluded
OpenRouter not used: no OpenRouter credential was found in Secrets Manager, the repository or the workstation environment
